Wedding Checklist with Dates: Know When to Do What

A wedding checklist that works from your own date. Agree on your top priorities about 14 months out, book the venue at 10 months and the photographer at 9. Send save-the-dates at 6 months and mail invitations about 10 weeks before. Add your wedding date and all 59 steps get a due date, with anything you're behind on flagged. Free.
